translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Mɑ Dɑrusi wi u sɑ̃ɑ Mɛdin bweseru u bɑndu di. Sɑɑ ye, u mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ wɑtɑ kɑ yiru.
Dɑniɛlin yibɛrɛbɑ
bɑ nùn yinɑ bɛriɑ
Dɑrusi u tɔmbu wunɑɑ teeru gɔsɑ bɑ n sɑ̃ɑ win tem beri berikɑn wirugibu.
Mɑ u tɔmbu itɑ gɔsɑ u bu kuɑ wirugii ben tɔnwerobu. Ben miyɑ wirugii be, bɑ ko n dɑ nɛ bu ben sɔmɑ tusiɑ. Kpɑ sunɔ u ku rɑɑ kɑ ɑsɑrɑ wɑ. Dɑniɛli u sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔnwero ben turo.
U beri berikɑn wirugii be, kɑ ben tɔnwerobu bwisi kere. Yen sɔ̃nɑ sinɑ boko u bwisikɑ u nùn ko tem mɛ kpuron wirugii.

Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Dɑniɛlin tɔnwerosii be, kɑ beri berikɑn wirugii be, bɑ nɔɔ tiɑ kuɑ bu kɑ nùn torɑru gɑru mɑni sinɑ bokon bɑndun swɑɑ sɔɔ. Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ torɑru gɑru wɑ wi sɔɔ. Domi u sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɑɑnɛgii, u ǹ kɔ̃sɑ gɑɑ koore. U ǹ mɑɑ sɔmburu gɑru ɑtɑfiiru koore.
Yerɑ tɔn be, bɑ nɛɛ, sɑ ǹ gɑ̃ɑnu gɑnu wɑsi su Dɑniɛli mɑni mɑ n kun mɔ ye yɑ sɑ̃ɑ win Gusunɔ sɑ̃ɑrun gɑri bɑɑsi.
Mɑ bɑ nɔɔ tiɑ kuɑ bɑ dɑ sinɑ bokon mi bɑ nɛɛ, yinni, wunɛn hunde yu dɑkɑɑ dɑ!

Bɛsɛ beri berikɑn wirugibu kɑ tɔnwerobu kɑ siri kowobu kɑ wunɛn wesiɑnɔsibu, bɛsɛ kpurowɑ sɑ nɔɔ tiɑ kuɑ ɑ kɑ woodɑ yɑrɑ ye yɑ gerumɔ bɑɑwure u nun sɑ̃ sere sɔ̃ɔ tɛnɑ. Wi u ye yinɑ mɑ u bũu goo ǹ kun mɛ tɔnu goo sɑ̃wɑ sere n kɑ ko sɔ̃ɔ tɛnɑ ye, bɑ koo yɛ̃ro kpɛ̃ɛwɑ wɔru mì sɔɔ gbee sinɑnsu wɑ̃ɑ.
Tɛ̃ yinni, ɑ woodɑ ye sireo ɑ nɔmɑ doke kpɑ yu ko nge Mɛdibɑ kɑ Pɛɛsibɑn woodɑ ye bɑ ku rɑ kɔsi.
Mɑ sinɑ boko u woodɑ ye nɔmɑ doke bɑ ye yɑrɑ.
Bɑ Dɑniɛli kpɛ̃ɛ
gbee sinɑnsun wɔruɔ

Sɑɑ ye Dɑniɛli u nuɑ mɑ bɑ woodɑ ye nɔmɑ doke, yerɑ u dɑ win gidɑmbisɑn wɔllɔ u duɑ yen dii sɔɔwɔ gèn fɛnɛnti yɑ wukiɑre Yerusɑlɛmun berɑ giɑ. Miyɑ u yiirɑ u kɑnɑru kuɑ u Gusunɔ siɑrɑ nge mɛ u rɑ ko tɔ̃ru bɑɑtere nɔn itɑ.
Yerɑ sɔ̃ɔ teeru tɔn be, bɑ nùn duwi bɑ deemɑ wee u Gusunɔ kɑnɑmɔ u somiru bikiɑmɔ.

Yen biru, tɔn be, bɑ yɑrɑ bɑ dɑ sinɑ bokon mi bɑ nùn woodɑ ye yɑɑyɑsiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, n ǹ wunɑ ɑ woodɑ yɑrɑ ye yɑ gerumɔ bu nun sɑ̃? N ǹ wunɑ ɑ nɛɛ, mɑ goo ù n bũu goo ǹ kun mɛ tɔnu goo sɑ̃wɑ sɔ̃ɔ tɛnɑn bɑɑ sɔɔ, bɑ koo yɛ̃ro kpɛ̃ɛwɑ wɔru ge sɔɔ, mi gbee sinɑnsu wɑ̃ɑ? Mɑ sinɑ boko u wurɑ u nɛɛ, woodɑ ye, yɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ dim dim nge mɛ Mɛdibɑ kɑ Pɛɛsibɑn woodɑ yɑ sɑ̃ɑ. N ǹ koorɔ bu ye kɔsi.
Mɑ bɑ nɛɛ, too, wee, Dɑniɛli wi u sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn turo be bɑ mwɛɛrimɑ Yudɑn di, u ǹ nun gɑrisi gɑ̃ɑnu, u ǹ mɑɑ wunɛn woodɑ ye ɑ nɔmu doke mi mɛm nɔɔwɛ. U rɑ win Gusunɔ kɑnɛwɑ tɔ̃ru bɑɑtere nɔn itɑ.
Ye sinɑ boko u gɑri yi nuɑ, yerɑ win nukurɑ sɑnkirɑ gem gem. Mɑ u gɔ̃ru doke u Dɑniɛli yɑrɑ woodɑ ye sɔɔn di. Mɑ u kookɑri kuɑ sere sɔ̃ɔ u kɑ duɑ.
Adɑmɑ tɔn be, bɑ kpɑm mɛnnɑ bɑ dɑ sinɑ bokon mi bɑ nɛɛ, ɑ yɑɑyo mɑ Mɛdibɑ kɑ Pɛɛsibɑn woodɑ yɑ ku rɑ kɔsi sinɑ boko ù n ye nɔmɑ doke.
Yerɑ sinɑ boko u woodɑ wɛ̃ u nɛɛ, bu Dɑniɛli yɑrɑmɑ bu kpɛ̃ɛ wɔru ge sɔɔ, mi gbee sinɑnsu wɑ̃ɑ mi. Sɑɑ yerɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinni wi ɑ sɑ̃ɑmɔ bɑɑdommɑ mi, u nun fɑɑbɑ koowo.
Mɑ bɑ kpee bɑkɑru tɑmɑ bɑ kɑ wɔru gen nɔɔ kɔruɑ. Yerɑ sinɑ boko u win tɑɑbu kɑ win sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbun yĩreru doke kpee ten wɔllɔ, goo u ku rɑɑ kɑ Dɑniɛli fɑɑbɑ ko.
Yen biru, u wurɑ win sinɑ kpɑɑrɔ. Wɔ̃ku te, u ǹ di, u ǹ nɔrɑ, u ǹ mɑɑ kpunɛ sinɑni goon bɔkuɔ. Mɛyɑ u ǹ mɑɑ dweeye dɔmɑ te.
Dɑniɛli u yɑrɑ bɑɑni
Yerɑ sinɑ boko Dɑrusi u seewɑ buru buru yellu u dɑ wɔru gen mi fuuku fuuku.
Ye u yɑm mi turuku kuɑ, yerɑ u Dɑniɛli sokum wɔri kɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu u mɔ̀, Dɑniɛli Gusunɔn sɔm kowo, Gusunɔ wi ɑ rɑ n sɑ̃ɑmɔ wɛ̃rɑbu sɑri mi, u kpĩɑ u nun wɔrɑ gbee sinɑn sin nɔɔn di?
Sɑɑ yerɑ Dɑniɛli u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, wunɛn hunde yu dɑkɑɑ dɑ!
Gusunɔ nɛn Yinni u win gɔrɑdo gɔrimɑ u gbee sinɑn sin nɔsu bɔkuɑ. Su ǹ mɑn mɛɛrɑ gɑɑ kue domi u wɑ mɑ nɑ ǹ torɑru gɑru kue win wuswɑɑɔ kɑ mɑɑ wunɛn wuswɑɑɔ.
Yerɑ sinɑ bokon nukurɑ dorɑ mɑ u woodɑ wɛ̃ u nɛɛ, bu Dɑniɛli yɑrɑmɑ sɑɑ wɔru gen min di. Ye bɑ Dɑniɛli yɑrɑmɑ, bɑ ǹ mɛɛrɑ gɑɑ wɑ win wɑsi sɔɔ. Domi u Gusunɔ win Yinni nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ.

Mɑ sinɑ boko u woodɑ wɛ̃ u nɛɛ, bu tɔn be bɑ rɑɑ Dɑniɛli tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃ mi mwɑɑmɑ bu kpɛ̃ɛ wɔru ge sɔɔ, be kɑ ben bibu kɑ ben kurɔbu kpuro. Tɔn be, bu sere mɑm turi wɔru gen temɔ, gbee sinɑn si, su bu sɛ̃sukɑwɑ su kukunu kɔsukɑ.
Yen biru, sinɑ boko u bwesenu kpuro tirenu yoruɑ u nɛɛ, ɑlɑfiɑ yɑ n sosimɔ bɛɛ sɔɔ yɑ n dɔɔ.
Woodɑ ye nɑ wɛ̃ɛmɔ wee. Be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ nɛn tem sɔɔ kpuro gesi, bu de bu Gusunɔ Dɑniɛlin Yinni nɑsiɑ kpɑ bu nùn bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃.

content.text: U ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Ten dɑm mu ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Wiyɑ u rɑ tɔnu wɔre u fɑɑbɑ ko.
U rɑ mɑɑmɑɑkibɑ kɑ yĩrenu ko wɔllɔ kɑ temɔ.
Wiyɑ u Dɑniɛli wɔrɑ gbee sinɑnsun nɔsun di.

content: Dɑrusin bɑndun wɑɑti ye sɔɔ, Dɑniɛli u kuɑ tɔn boko sere n kɑ girɑri Sirusi Pɛɛsin bɑndu sɔɔ.
